prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: portrait game sidebar design preview, high fidelity, not a website screenshot. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: original classic Lineage ability panel artwork. Keep original late-1990s PC Lineage visual language: charcoal brown stone/leather background, thin worn brass/copper frames, ivory and muted gold Traditional Chinese typography, narrow glossy beveled red HP, blue MP and amber EXP bars. No modern flat dashboard, no neon, no decorative hero art, no invented action buttons. Show the entire compact sidebar at a realistic readable scale, around 680px wide and 950px tall. Preserve all existing information and rows: 4 player allies (法師, 妖精, 騎士, 妖精; Lv.37), 1 pet 袋鼠 Lv.35, 1 ally summon 狂野毒牙, 1 castle guard 毒蛇之牙. Use anonymous sample names 法師甲, 妖精乙, 騎士丙, 妖精丁 only. Four allies have EXP 24.2%, 0.3%,34.6%,34.0% and HP/MP bars with exact values 262/332 & 264/521, 307/453 & 198/219, 917/917 & 47/47, 276/428 & 93/165. Pet 180/180 HP,2/98 MP and HP<70%喝水. Summon356/400HP, guard455/455HP. Header text 隊伍與夥伴 with 隊伍 and 技能設定 tabs. Small authentic pixel sprites only where useful; no large portraits. Data stays single line and tightly aligned. Make sharp, implementable UI rather than decorative fantasy painting. Variant A — 經典精簡卡片. Preserve the current four stacked ally cards, but cut their height and empty padding about 25%. On each card first row: tiny class sigil, name/class and level; second very thin EXP bar; third red HP and blue MP bars side by side. Keep pet, summon and guard grouped below with matching narrow frames. Small restrained brass ornamentation at the header corners only. Tiny A label at upper left outside the frame. This is the closest modernization of the original panel.
